verdant_cascade_circuit.visual_theme: Riverside garden circuit under mist and pale daylight.
verdant_cascade_circuit.route_rhythm: Wide opening straight, sweeping garden bend, runoff pocket, climb back to the falls.
verdant_cascade_circuit.signature_section: Mist columns over the inner river cut.
verdant_cascade_circuit.shortcut_style: Wet inner cut — save time if you keep the line, wash out if you overcommit.
verdant_cascade_circuit.audio_direction: Water and leaf hush under the existing verdant race bed.
verdant_cascade_circuit.challenge_identity: Read the runoff. Beginner-friendly unless you force the wet cut.

cloverwind_ranch.visual_theme: Sunlit clover fields, timber, and hay.
cloverwind_ranch.route_rhythm: Open pasture sprint, gate squeeze, muddy alley option, windy back stretch.
cloverwind_ranch.signature_section: Timber gate into the barn alley decision.
cloverwind_ranch.shortcut_style: Mud alley — shorter, sloppy steering, cheap to miss.
cloverwind_ranch.audio_direction: Open-air wind and timber creak under the ranch race bed.
cloverwind_ranch.challenge_identity: Commit early to the alley or keep the dry pasture.

tideglass_harbor.visual_theme: Glassy piers, pale tide flats, and a harbor beacon.
tideglass_harbor.route_rhythm: Wide runoff start, pier jump choice, glass straight, lighthouse close.
tideglass_harbor.shortcut_style: Medium risk jump cut — readable, punish over-brake.
tideglass_harbor.audio_direction: Tide slap and gull-distance hush under the harbor race bed.
tideglass_harbor.challenge_identity: Newcomer-wide runoff with one brave pier line.

neon_switchyard.visual_theme: Freight corridors, magenta gantries, night yard tower.
neon_switchyard.route_rhythm: Tight switch, neon speed lane, rail-cut dare, tower rejoin.
neon_switchyard.shortcut_style: High-risk rail cut — late entry is a wall, not a bonus.
neon_switchyard.audio_direction: Hum and switch-clack under the neon race bed.
neon_switchyard.challenge_identity: Read the gantry early or stay on the freight floor.

cloudstep_ridge.visual_theme: High shelves, pale mist, and cliff light.
cloudstep_ridge.route_rhythm: Shelf climb, mist slowdown, cliff-bounce option, ridge rejoin.
cloudstep_ridge.shortcut_style: High-risk bounce — miss the pad and you eat the shelf.
cloudstep_ridge.audio_direction: Thin wind and distant drop under the ridge race bed.
cloudstep_ridge.challenge_identity: Elevation and mist. The bounce is a choice, not a door puzzle.

prism_apex.visual_theme: Orbital ribbon, sparse rails, alternating color sectors.
prism_apex.route_rhythm: Precision boost gates, ribbon cut, void rejoin.
prism_apex.signature_section: Narrow ribbon cut between color sectors.
prism_apex.shortcut_style: Narrow precision cut — always tempting, expensive to miss.
prism_apex.audio_direction: Soft harmonic bed already authored for Prism. No extra commercial music.
prism_apex.challenge_identity: Precision over power. The ribbon is a skill check.

mirage_mesa.visual_theme: Sun-baked banks, sand haze, long draft straights.
mirage_mesa.route_rhythm: Long straight, wash decision, banked mesa, heat-haze close.
mirage_mesa.signature_section: Dry wash under the mesa arch.
mirage_mesa.shortcut_style: Sand wash — shorter if you keep speed, a trap if you plow.
mirage_mesa.audio_direction: Dry wind and grit under the mesa race bed.
mirage_mesa.challenge_identity: Drafting straights plus a wash that is never free.

emberkeep_gauntlet.visual_theme: Basalt keep, forge vents, ash courtyards.
emberkeep_gauntlet.route_rhythm: Fortress entry, vent cut, ash patches, courtyard finish.
emberkeep_gauntlet.signature_section: Forge vent cut into the final courtyard.
emberkeep_gauntlet.shortcut_style: Ash vent — fast if you hold the line, blind if you panic-steer.
emberkeep_gauntlet.audio_direction: Low forge rumble under the Emberkeep race bed.
emberkeep_gauntlet.challenge_identity: Expert courtyard close. The vent is a dare, not a mandatory skip.
